remarks: Immaculate inside and out, and terrific location to boot! Welcome home to 7 Hoover Rd, where you can cozy up in the living room with fireplace, prepare a fabulous dinner in the beautifully remodeled kitchen with soft-close cabinets with granite tops, stainless steel appliances, and enjoy an informal meal at your 9' breakfast bar, which is incidentally is open to the formal dining room. Step out in the sunroom from the living room, or step outside to your patio from the kitchen and enjoy your private property that has just the right amount of lawn. One bedroom is on the main level, and the full bath with a walk-in shower is simply stunning.The other two bedrooms are upstairs, along with an oversized bath. Downstairs in the lower level, there is a nice sized den/office, while still maintaining plenty of storage area. It just feels like home the moment you enter. Make it yours today!
